profile.headline: MS in Game Programming from DePaul University exploring software engineering opportunities
profile.summary: I am currently a Software Quality Assurance Engineer at Light & Wonder. I received my Master's Degree in Game Programming from DePaul University in 2023. My coursework included optimized C++, multithreading, and graphics programming with OpenGL.

projects.title: Game Engine
projects.description:
Real-Time Software Development I & II
Developed a math library architected to benefit from SIMD optimization. Used OpenGL to handle graphics. Created a tool to convert GLTF files into an engine specific file format. Used Google Protocol Buffers to serialize data.

projects.title: Audio Engine
projects.description:
Real-Time Multithreaded Architecture
Developed a multithreaded audio engine using Microsoft’s XAudio2 API. Separate threads were used to manage audio playback, asynchronous and synchronous file loading, and the main application.
